We do know that it is possible for tree metrics (in view of Theorem 15), and that in general it is at most exponential (by Theorem 10). 3 Online embedding into trees In tree embeddings we refer to online embeddings that constructs a tree whose vertices may contain Steiner points. That is, the constructed tree, besides the points corresponding to the input metric, may contain additional points. At each step, once a new vertex is exposed, the embedding algorithm picks an existing edge of the tree, subdivide it (without changing its total weight) by creating a new Steiner point, and attaches to it the new vertex by a new edge of a corresponding weight. The new edge is always a leaf, except when the weight is 0. I Theorem 2. Any metric on n points can be deterministically online embedded into a tree with distortion ≤ 2n−1 − 1, even without using Steiner points.
